raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With TP > 1 and a softcapped lm_head, DFLASH verify finishes the logits all-gather in the worker. For a sampled batch it then:

- all-gathers the full fp32 logits of every verify row, `[bs * block, vocab]`;
- softcaps them and runs a radix top-k over the whole vocabulary;
- scatters the target p and the draft selector's q into vocab-sized tensors;
- runs the chain sampler, which scans the whole vocabulary.

When the requests sample with a top-k, as many generation configs do by default, only the top-k tokens of a row carry target mass. Almost all of that work reads and writes zeros, and the gather moves the largest tensor of the step across the TP group.

With this PR, such a batch is verified on the top-k support alone:

- each rank takes the top `next_power_of_2(max_top_k + 16)` logits of its vocab shard. The 16 spare slots hold logits tied with the k-th one;
- the ranks all-gather those (value, id) pairs instead of their shards. At TP8 and a 202K vocabulary, that is 1 KB per row from each rank instead of 101 KB;
- one Triton kernel softcaps and merges the candidates into each row's exact top-k and argmax. It uses the softcap formula of the dense gather, so the kept values equal the dense row's bit for bit;
- one Triton kernel runs the chain accept and the residual resample on that support. It makes the dense path's two uniform draws in the same order. It adapts the top-k chain sampler of #41283 to DFLASH's exactly-k top-k and sparse q.

A batch that the support cannot reproduce keeps the dense path. That covers max top_k above 64 (top_k -1 included), top-p, min-p, penalties, logit bias, a custom logit processor, grammar, logprobs, sampling-mask capture, block verification and padded vocab shards. Greedy batches already take `deferred_argmax`.

Up to fp32 rounding, only two cases can differ from the dense path, and both stay exact top-k sampling:

- a tie at rank k keeps the lowest ids, where `torch.topk` breaks it arbitrarily;
- if q >= p over the whole support, the bonus is sampled from p. The dense kernel emits the last vocabulary id there.

With the DFlash2 selector draft, the kernels compile at startup, outside any collective, for top_k 64, and the two support kernels for top_k 49-64. Any other top_k or draft compiles on its first sampled verify.

#41916 changes top-k/top-p filtering only for batches that use top-p, which keep the dense path here, so this PR stays exact with or without it. Related open PRs on the verify sampling path: #41957, #43052, #44668.

## How to enable

```bash
SGLANG_OPT_DFLASH_SPARSE_VERIFY=1   # default off
```

Requires:
- `--speculative-algorithm DFLASH` with a draft that samples its proposals, such as the DFlash2 candidate selector;
- CUDA and TP > 1;
- a target with `final_logit_softcapping`, so that verify defers the logits gather;
- requests sampled with top_k <= 64.

Other batches are unchanged.

## Performance

Muse-Spark-Open NVFP4, 8x GB300, TP8, DFLASH with 8 draft tokens. Requests sample with the model's generation config (top_k 64). The acceptance length is held at 4.05 on both sides.

This PR alone; baseline and this PR use the same build, and only `SGLANG_OPT_DFLASH_SPARSE_VERIFY` differs:

| Concurrency | Throughput per GPU (tok/s), baseline | Throughput per GPU (tok/s), this PR | Per-user decode speed, P90 (tok/s/user), baseline | Per-user decode speed, P90 (tok/s/user), this PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 8,974 | 9,059 (+0.9%) | 414.4 | 430.6 (+3.9%) |

With #45895's fc split: the "this PR" column also splits the draft's context fc across the TP ranks at verify, as #45895 proposes; the baseline has neither change.

| Concurrency | Throughput per GPU (tok/s), baseline | Throughput per GPU (tok/s), this PR + fc split | Per-user decode speed, P90 (tok/s/user), baseline | Per-user decode speed, P90 (tok/s/user), this PR + fc split |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 4,730 | 4,813 (+1.8%) | 490.7 | 513.6 (+4.7%) |
| 10 | 8,943 | 8,908 (-0.4%) | 413.8 | 432.8 (+4.6%) |
| 16 | 13,915 | 14,022 (+0.8%) | 354.1 | 368.7 (+4.1%) |

Throughput per GPU counts input and output tokens. Per-user decode speed excludes time to first token; P90 is the speed 90% of requests reach.

## Tests

`test/registered/kernels/ops/speculative/test_dflash_sparse_verify.py` (new, CUDA). It runs through the worker's own support and accept methods, at a 202,048 vocab, with TP 1/2/4/8 simulated by a rank-major all-gather. It checks:
- the merged support equals `torch.topk` of the full softcapped rows, and its argmax equals `torch.argmax`;
- accept length, bonus token and the RNG stream after verify equal the dense selector verify's, at bs 1-4 and temperatures 0.6/1.0/1.3 with top_k 64;
- the same on peaked rows that accept whole blocks, so the bonus comes from the last row;
- the same on a mixed top_k `[64, 20, 1, 64]` batch with a greedy row.

`test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_logits.py`, 2 new CPU tests:
- every unsupported batch keeps the dense gather, including top_k 65, `[64, 128]`, top_k -1 and the flag off;
- a supported batch packs its shard with rank-major global ids and gathers `world * rows` rows.

nodes.body:
[by Claude Code] This review is done by agents. Please feel free to disagree if they do not make sense.

[by Claude Code] **Severity: functional | Confidence: Medium**

**Issue**

With the flag on, the new kernels decide which draft tokens are accepted and which bonus token is sampled, so this change can affect model outputs. The description has before/after speed results for Muse-Spark-Open NVFP4 on GB300, but no accuracy result. The acceptance length in the Performance section is not an output-quality score, and the parity tests use synthetic logits only.

**Fix**

Please add one accuracy score, for example GSM8K or GPQA, for Muse-Spark-Open NVFP4 on GB300 with `SGLANG_OPT_DFLASH_SPARSE_VERIFY` off and on. Use top_k 64 sampling so the sparse path runs.

[by Claude Code] **Severity: functional | Confidence: High**

**Issue**

`_sparse_verify` does not check that the target has a final logit softcap. With `SGLANG_OPT_DFLASH_SPARSE_VERIFY=1`, a target without softcap, a selector draft, and TP > 1, `prewarm_sampling` calls `_prewarm_sparse_verify`. It passes `final_logit_softcapping=None` to `merge_shard_topk` (line 873). Triton turns a `None` argument into a constexpr, so `x = x / softcap` in `_merge_support_kernel` fails to compile and the scheduler fails at startup. The startup log also says sparse verify is enabled, but verify never defers the gather for such a target.

**Fix**

Add `and bool(self._target_logits_processor.final_logit_softcapping)` to this condition. That matches the softcap check in `LogitsProcessor._can_gather_softcap_fused`.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,352 @@
+"""DFLASH sampled verify on each row's top-k support, from the target's vocab shards.
+
+With a top-k, only the top-k tokens of a verify row carry target mass. The dense
+selector verify still all-gathers the fp32 logits of every row, softcaps them, runs
+a radix top-k, scatters p and the selector's q into dense vocab-sized tensors and
+scans the vocabulary in the chain sampler. Here instead:
+
+1. ``pack_shard_topk``: each TP rank packs the top-``W`` (``W >= max top_k``) of
+   its raw logits shard as int32 (value bits, global id) pairs, which the caller
+   all-gathers rank-major;
+2. ``merge_shard_topk``: softcap the ``world * W`` candidates as
+   ``gathered_softcap_logits`` does, sort by (value desc, id asc), keep the first
+   ``max_top_k`` and the row argmax (lowest id among maxima, as ``torch.argmax``);
+3. ``sparse_chain_speculative_sampling``: the accept rule and residual resample of
+   ``chain_speculative_sampling_triton`` with p the softmax over the row's kept
+   top-k and q looked up in the selector's candidates.
+
+Off the support p = 0, so the support holds the whole residual. The final CDF is
+walked in token-id order, the order the dense kernel scans the vocabulary, so both
+pick the same token for the same coin up to fp32 summation order. The accept
+kernel adapts the top-k chain sampler of sgl-project/sglang#41283 to an exactly-k
+top-k and a sparse q.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Tuple
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+from triton.language.extra import libdevice
+
+try:
+    from flashinfer import top_k as _flashinfer_top_k
+except ImportError:
+    _flashinfer_top_k = None
+
+
+def shard_topk_width(max_top_k: int) -> int:
+    """Per-shard top-k width. The 16 extra slots keep logits tied with the k-th one,
+    common with bf16 logits; the merge keeps the lowest ids among ties, a valid
+    exactly-k truncation whose tied ids may differ from torch.topk's."""
+    return triton.next_power_of_2(max_top_k + 16)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pack_shard_topk_kernel(
+    vals_ptr,
+    ids_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    vals_row_stride,
+    ids_row_stride,
+    col_offset,
+    W: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # out[row] = [float bits of the W values | W global ids], int32.
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, W)
+    v = tl.load(vals_ptr + row * vals_row_stride + offs)
+    i = tl.load(ids_ptr + row * ids_row_stride + offs).to(tl.int32) + col_offset
+    base = out_ptr + row * (2 * W)
+    tl.store(base + offs, v.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True))
+    tl.store(base + W + offs, i)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _merge_support_kernel(
+    gathered_ptr,  # [world, rows, 2W] int32
+    sup_vals_ptr,  # [rows, K_BLOCK] fp32, softcapped, sorted desc
+    sup_ids_ptr,  # [rows, K_BLOCK] int32
+    argmax_ptr,  # [rows] int64
+    num_rows,
+    softcap,
+    W: tl.constexpr,
+    WORLD: tl.constexpr,
+    N_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,  # next_power_of_2(WORLD * W)
+    K_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, N_BLOCK)
+    valid = offs < WORLD * W
+    r = (offs // W).to(tl.int64)
+    c = (offs % W).to(tl.int64)
+    base = gathered_ptr + (r * num_rows + row) * (2 * W)
+    bits = tl.load(base + c, mask=valid, other=0)
+    ids = tl.load(base + W + c, mask=valid, other=0)
+    x = bits.to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+    # gathered_softcap_logits' formula, so kept values match the dense row bit for bit.
+    x = x / softcap
+    x = libdevice.tanh(x)
+    x = x * softcap
+    # Padding lanes sort last: -inf below every finite logit.
+    x = tl.where(valid, x, float("-inf"))
+    ids = tl.where(valid, ids, 0x7FFFFFFF)
+    # Order-preserving signed int32 of the float, then (value desc, id asc) in one
+    # int64 key: the low half holds 0x7FFFFFFF - id, which never touches the sign.
+    xb = x.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True)
+    ordered = tl.where(xb >= 0, xb, xb ^ 0x7FFFFFFF)
+    key = (ordered.to(tl.int64) << 32) | (0x7FFFFFFF - ids).to(tl.int64)
+    key = tl.sort(key, descending=True)
+    out_ids = (0x7FFFFFFF - (key & 0xFFFFFFFF)).to(tl.int32)
+    hi = (key >> 32).to(tl.int32)
+    out_bits = tl.where(hi >= 0, hi, hi ^ 0x7FFFFFFF)
+    out_vals = out_bits.to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+    keep = offs < K_BLOCK
+    tl.store(sup_vals_ptr + row * K_BLOCK + offs, out_vals, mask=keep)
+    tl.store(sup_ids_ptr + row * K_BLOCK + offs, out_ids, mask=keep)
+    first = tl.sum(tl.where(offs == 0, out_ids, 0))
+    tl.store(argmax_ptr + row, first.to(tl.int64))
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _support_probs(
+    sup_vals_ptr,
+    row,
+    offs,
+    kept,
+    temperature,
+    K_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    # softmax over the kept top-k of (logit / temperature), the dense path's
+    # masked F.softmax(topk_logits) restricted to the support.
+    z = tl.load(sup_vals_ptr + row * K_BLOCK + offs)
+    z = z / temperature
+    z = tl.where(kept, z, float("-inf"))
+    e = tl.where(kept, tl.exp(z - tl.max(z, axis=0)), 0.0)
+    return e / tl.sum(e, axis=0)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _sparse_chain_accept_kernel(
+    sup_vals_ptr,  # [bs * NUM_SLOTS, K_BLOCK] fp32
+    sup_ids_ptr,  # [bs * NUM_SLOTS, K_BLOCK] int32
+    temps_ptr,  # [bs, 1] fp32
+    temps_stride,
+    top_ks_ptr,  # [bs] int
+    candidates_ptr,  # [bs, NUM_SLOTS] int64
+    cand_stride,
+    q_ids_ptr,  # [bs, NUM_SLOTS - 1, KS] int64 (selector candidate ids)
+    q_ids_stride_b,
+    q_ids_stride_s,
+    q_vals_ptr,  # [bs, NUM_SLOTS - 1, KS] fp32 (selector q)
+    q_vals_stride_b,
+    q_vals_stride_s,
+    uni_ptr,  # [bs, NUM_SLOTS - 1] fp32
+    uni_stride,
+    uni_final_ptr,  # [bs] fp32
+    correct_len_ptr,  # [bs] int32
+    bonus_ptr,  # [bs] int64
+    max_top_k,
+    vocab_size,
+    NUM_SLOTS: tl.constexpr,
+    K_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    KS: tl.constexpr,
+    KS_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    pid = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    offs = tl.arange(0, K_BLOCK)
+    ks = tl.arange(0, KS_BLOCK)
+    ks_mask = ks < KS
+    temperature = tl.load(temps_ptr + pid * temps_stride).to(tl.float32)
+    top_k = tl.load(top_ks_ptr + pid).to(tl.int32)
+    top_k = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(top_k, 1), vocab_size)
+    top_k = tl.minimum(top_k, max_top_k)
+    kept = offs < top_k
+
+    num_correct = 0
+    cur_row = 0
+    step = 1
+    go = 1
+    while (step < NUM_SLOTS) and (go == 1):
+        draft_token = tl.load(candidates_ptr + pid * cand_stride + step).to(tl.int32)
+        row = pid * NUM_SLOTS + cur_row
+        ids = tl.load(sup_ids_ptr + row * K_BLOCK + offs)
+        probs = _support_probs(sup_vals_ptr, row, offs, kept, temperature, K_BLOCK)
+        p = tl.sum(tl.where(kept & (ids == draft_token), probs, 0.0), axis=0)
+        qi = tl.load(
+            q_ids_ptr + pid * q_ids_stride_b + cur_row * q_ids_stride_s + ks,
+            mask=ks_mask,
+            other=-1,
+        ).to(tl.int32)
+        qv = tl.load(
+            q_vals_ptr + pid * q_vals_stride_b + cur_row * q_vals_stride_s + ks,
+            mask=ks_mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        q = tl.sum(tl.where(qi == draft_token, qv, 0.0), axis=0)
+        coin = tl.load(uni_ptr + pid * uni_stride + (step - 1))
+        q_is_prob = (q > 0.0) & (q <= 1.0)
+        if q_is_prob & (coin * q < p):
+            num_correct += 1
+            cur_row = step
+            step += 1
+        else:
+            go = 0
+
+    tl.store(correct_len_ptr + pid, num_correct.to(tl.int32))
+
+    row = pid * NUM_SLOTS + cur_row
+    ids = tl.load(sup_ids_ptr + row * K_BLOCK + offs)
+    p_val = _support_probs(sup_vals_ptr, row, offs, kept, temperature, K_BLOCK)
+    if go == 1:
+        # Every draft accepted: sample the bonus from p of the last row.
+        val = p_val
+    else:
+        # q at each support id: the selector's candidate ids are distinct per
+        # row, so the matching entry is the scattered dense q.
+        qi = tl.load(
+            q_ids_ptr + pid * q_ids_stride_b + cur_row * q_ids_stride_s + ks,
+            mask=ks_mask,
+            other=-1,
+        ).to(tl.int32)
+        qv = tl.load(
+            q_vals_ptr + pid * q_vals_stride_b + cur_row * q_vals_stride_s + ks,
+            mask=ks_mask,
+            other=0.0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        match = ids[:, None] == qi[None, :]
+        q_sup = tl.sum(tl.where(match, qv[None, :], 0.0), axis=1)

+"""DFLASH sparse top-k verify (SGLANG_OPT_DFLASH_SPARSE_VERIFY) against the dense
+selector verify, through the worker's own support and accept methods."""
+
+import sys
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.activation.softcap import gathered_softcap_logits
+from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_batch_info import SamplingBatchInfo
+from sglang.srt.speculative import dflash_worker_v2 as worker_mod
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=120, stage="base-b-kernel-unit", runner_config="1-gpu-large")
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="CUDA required")
+
+# A vocab divisible by 8 TP ranks, Gemma-style softcap 20, 8 verify tokens, selector
+# top_k 16, generation-config top_k 64.
+VOCAB = 202048
+BLOCK = 8
+SELECTOR_TOP_K = 16
+SOFTCAP = 20.0
+GRAPH_BUCKET_BS = 4
+
+
+class _SimulatedTpGroup:
+    """The tp_group surface the support reads, for ``world`` ranks simulated on one
+    GPU; the all-gather is rank-major, as NCCL's all_gather_into_tensor."""
+
+    def __init__(self, world, rank, packed):
+        self.world_size = world
+        self.rank_in_group = rank
+        self._packed = packed
+
+    def all_gather_into_tensor(self, output, input):
+        self._packed[self.rank_in_group] = input.clone()
+        if len(self._packed) == self.world_size:
+            output.copy_(torch.cat([self._packed[r] for r in range(self.world_size)]))
+        else:
+            output.zero_()
+
+
+def _worker(*, block_verification=False):
+    worker = worker_mod.DFlashWorkerV2.__new__(worker_mod.DFlashWorkerV2)
+    worker._sparse_verify = True
+    worker._selector_sample = (None, None)
+    worker._block_verification = block_verification
+    worker._draft_probs_buf = None
+    worker._target_logits_processor = SimpleNamespace(
+        vocab_size=VOCAB, final_logit_softcapping=SOFTCAP
+    )
+    return worker
+
+
+def _make_case(*, bs, top_ks, temperature, seed, scale=3.0, noise=0.3, peak=0.0):
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    rows = bs * BLOCK
+    raw = torch.randn(rows, VOCAB, device="cuda", generator=gen) * scale
+    if peak:
+        spikes = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (rows,), device="cuda", generator=gen)
+        raw[torch.arange(rows, device="cuda"), spikes] += peak
+    # Graph replay hands verify the first bs * block rows of a larger bucket's
+    # buffer; bf16-rounded values put ties at the top-k boundary.
+    bucket = torch.zeros(GRAPH_BUCKET_BS * BLOCK, VOCAB, device="cuda")
+    bucket[:rows] = raw.bfloat16().float()
+    raw = bucket[:rows]
+    capped = (torch.tanh(raw / SOFTCAP) * SOFTCAP).view(bs, BLOCK, VOCAB)
+    q_ids = torch.empty(bs, BLOCK - 1, SELECTOR_TOP_K, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+    q_rows = torch.empty(bs, BLOCK - 1, SELECTOR_TOP_K, device="cuda")
+    candidates = torch.empty(bs, BLOCK, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+    candidates[:, 0] = torch.randint(0, VOCAB, (bs,), device="cuda", generator=gen)
+    for slot in range(BLOCK - 1):
+        noisy = (
+            capped[:, slot]
+            + torch.randn(bs, VOCAB, device="cuda", generator=gen) * noise
+        )
+        vals, ids = torch.topk(noisy, SELECTOR_TOP_K, dim=-1)
+        q = torch.softmax(vals * 1.3, dim=-1)
+        q_ids[:, slot] = ids
+        q_rows[:, slot] = q
+        pick = torch.multinomial(q, 1, generator=gen).squeeze(1)
+        candidates[:, slot + 1] = ids.gather(1, pick[:, None]).squeeze(1)
+    sampling_info = SamplingBatchInfo(
+        temperatures=torch.full((bs, 1), temperature, device="cuda"),
+        top_ps=torch.ones(bs, device="cuda"),
+        top_ks=torch.tensor(top_ks, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        min_ps=torch.zeros(bs, device="cuda"),
+        is_all_greedy=False,
+        is_any_greedy=1 in top_ks,
+        need_top_p_sampling=False,
+        need_top_k_sampling=True,
+        need_min_p_sampling=False,
+        vocab_size=VOCAB,
+    )
+    draft_input = SimpleNamespace(
+        max_top_k=max(top_ks),
+        uniform_top_k_value=top_ks[0] if len(set(top_ks)) == 1 else None,
+    )
+    return raw, candidates, q_ids, q_rows, sampling_info, draft_input
+
+
+def _rank_shards(raw, world):
+    """Each rank's logits shard in its own contiguous lm_head output buffer; verify
+    reads the first bs * block rows of a larger graph bucket's buffer."""
+    rows = raw.shape[0]
+    shard = VOCAB // world
+    shards = []
+    for rank in range(world):
+        bucket = torch.zeros(GRAPH_BUCKET_BS * BLOCK, shard, device=raw.device)
+        bucket[:rows] = raw[:, rank * shard : (rank + 1) * shard]
+        shards.append(bucket[:rows])
+    return shards
+
+
+def _support_on_every_rank(*, raw, world, sampling_info, draft_input):
+    shards = _rank_shards(raw, world)
+    packed = {}
+    # Pass 1 records every rank's packed shard; pass 2 gathers them all.
+    for _ in range(2):
+        supports = []
+        for rank in range(world):
+            parallel = SimpleNamespace(
+                tp_group=_SimulatedTpGroup(world, rank, packed), tp_rank=rank
+            )
+            with mock.patch.object(worker_mod, "get_parallel", return_value=parallel):
+                supports.append(
+                    _worker()._sparse_verify_support(
+                        batch=SimpleNamespace(has_grammar=False, return_logprob=False),
+                        sampling_info=sampling_info,
+                        draft_input=draft_input,
+                        logits_shard=shards[rank],
+                    )
+                )
+    return supports
+
+
+def _dense_full_logits(raw, world):
+    """finish_deferred_gather: the rank-major gather of the shards, softcapped."""
+    shard = VOCAB // world
+    gathered = torch.stack(
+        [raw[:, r * shard : (r + 1) * shard] for r in range(world)]
+    ).contiguous()
+    full = torch.empty(raw.shape[0], VOCAB, dtype=torch.float32, device=raw.device)
+    return gathered_softcap_logits(gathered, SOFTCAP, full)
+
+
+def _check_parity(*, world, bs, top_ks, temperature, trials, seed, **case_kw):
+    stats = dict(all_accepted=0, rejected=0)
+    for t in range(trials):
+        raw, cands, q_ids, q_rows, sampling_info, draft_input = _make_case(
+            bs=bs, top_ks=top_ks, temperature=temperature, seed=seed + t, **case_kw
+        )
+        supports = _support_on_every_rank(
+            raw=raw, world=world, sampling_info=sampling_info, draft_input=draft_input
+        )
+        for other in supports[1:]:
+            for a, b in zip(supports[0], other):
+                torch.testing.assert_close(a, b, rtol=0, atol=0)
+        sup_vals, _, argmax = supports[0]
+        full = _dense_full_logits(raw, world)
+        k = draft_input.max_top_k
+        # The merged support is the top-k of the full softcapped rows, sorted desc.
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            sup_vals[:, :k], torch.topk(full, k, dim=-1).values, rtol=0, atol=0
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(argmax, torch.argmax(full, dim=-1), rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+        accept_kw = dict(
+            candidates=cands,
+            candidate_ids=q_ids,
+            q_rows=q_rows,
+            sampling_info=sampling_info,
+            draft_input=draft_input,
+        )
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed(1000 + t)
+        dense = _worker()._selector_sampling_accept(next_token_logits=full, **accept_kw)
+        dense_probe = torch.rand(4, device="cuda")
+        torch.cuda.manual_seed(1000 + t)
+        sparse = _worker()._selector_sparse_accept(support=supports[0], **accept_kw)
+        sparse_probe = torch.rand(4, device="cuda")
+        msg = f"world={world} bs={bs} top_ks={top_ks} T={temperature} trial={t}"
+        assert torch.equal(dense[0], sparse[0]), msg
+        assert torch.equal(dense[1], sparse[1]), msg
+        # Same draws in the same order: the sampler's RNG stream continues identically.
+        assert torch.equal(dense_probe, sparse_probe), msg
+        stats["all_accepted"] += int((dense[0] == BLOCK - 1).sum())
+        stats["rejected"] += int((dense[0] < BLOCK - 1).sum())
+    return stats
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("world", [1, 2, 4, 8])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bs", [1, 2, 3, 4])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("temperature", [0.6, 1.0, 1.3])
+def test_top_k_64_matches_the_dense_verify(world, bs, temperature):
+    stats = _check_parity(
+        world=world,
+        bs=bs,
+        top_ks=[64] * bs,
+        temperature=temperature,
+        trials=6,
+        seed=17 * world + 101 * bs,
+    )
+    assert stats["rejected"] > 0
+
+
+def test_long_accepts_sample_the_bonus_from_the_last_row():
+    stats = _check_parity(
+        world=8,
+        bs=4,
+        top_ks=[64] * 4,
+        temperature=1.0,
+        trials=40,
+        seed=7,
+        scale=1.0,
+        noise=0.01,
+        peak=10.0,
+    )
+    assert stats["all_accepted"] > 0 and stats["rejected"] > 0
+
+
+def test_mixed_top_k_and_greedy_rows_match_the_dense_verify():
+    # Non-uniform top_k masks ranks per row; top_k 1 is a greedy row.
+    _check_parity(
+        world=8,
+        bs=4,
+        top_ks=[64, 20, 1, 64],
+        temperature=0.7,
+        trials=30,
+        seed=3,
+        scale=2.0,
+        noise=0.02,
+        peak=6.0,
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))

+_SPARSE_WORLD = 4

+def _sparse_verify_support(
+    monkeypatch,
+    *,
+    rank=0,
+    top_ks=(64, 20, 1, 64),
+    shard_width=_SPARSE_SHARD,
+    worker_fields=(),
+    batch_fields=(),
+    sampling_fields=(),
+):
+    """``_sparse_verify_support`` on rank ``rank`` of 4 for 8-token verify blocks."""
+    from sglang.srt.speculative import dflash_worker_v2 as worker_mod
+
+    bs = len(top_ks)
+    sampling_info = SamplingBatchInfo(
+        temperatures=torch.ones(bs, 1),
+        top_ps=torch.ones(bs),
+        top_ks=torch.tensor(top_ks, dtype=torch.int32),
+        min_ps=torch.zeros(bs),
+        is_all_greedy=False,
+        is_any_greedy=1 in top_ks,
+        need_top_p_sampling=False,
+        need_top_k_sampling=any(k != TOP_K_ALL for k in top_ks),
+        need_min_p_sampling=False,
+        vocab_size=_SPARSE_WORLD * _SPARSE_SHARD,
+    )
+    worker = worker_mod.DFlashWorkerV2.__new__(worker_mod.DFlashWorkerV2)
+    worker._sparse_verify = True
+    worker._selector_sample = (None, None)
+    worker._block_verification = False
+    worker._target_logits_processor = SimpleNamespace(
+        vocab_size=_SPARSE_WORLD * _SPARSE_SHARD, final_logit_softcapping=20.0
+    )
+    batch = SimpleNamespace(has_grammar=False, return_logprob=False)
+    for target, fields in (
+        (worker, worker_fields),
+        (batch, batch_fields),
+        (sampling_info, sampling_fields),
+    ):
+        for name, value in dict(fields).items():
+            setattr(target, name, value)
+    gathered = []
+    group = SimpleNamespace(
+        world_size=_SPARSE_WORLD,
+        rank_in_group=rank,
+        all_gather_into_tensor=lambda output, input: gathered.append(output.shape),
+    )
+    parallel = SimpleNamespace(tp_group=group, tp_rank=rank)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(worker_mod, "get_parallel", lambda: parallel)
+    support = worker._sparse_verify_support(
+        batch=batch,
+        sampling_info=sampling_info,
+        draft_input=SimpleNamespace(max_top_k=max(top_ks)),
+        logits_shard=torch.zeros(bs * 8, shard_width),
+    )
+    return support, gathered
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "case",
+    [
+        dict(top_ks=(65,)),
+        dict(top_ks=(64, 128)),
+        dict(top_ks=(64, TOP_K_ALL)),
+        dict(top_ks=(TOP_K_ALL, TOP_K_ALL)),
+        dict(shard_width=_SPARSE_SHARD + 1),
+        dict(sampling_fields={"need_top_p_sampling": True}),
+        dict(sampling_fields={"need_min_p_sampling": True}),
+        dict(sampling_fields={"has_custom_logit_processor": True}),
+        dict(
+            sampling_fields={
+                "penalizer_orchestrator": SimpleNamespace(is_required=True)
+            }
+        ),
+        dict(sampling_fields={"logit_bias": torch.zeros(1)}),
+        dict(sampling_fields={"grammar_mask": object()}),
+        dict(sampling_fields={"sampling_mask_batch_indices": torch.zeros(1)}),
+        dict(batch_fields={"has_grammar": True}),
+        dict(batch_fields={"return_logprob": True}),
+        dict(worker_fields={"_block_verification": True}),
+        dict(worker_fields={"_selector_sample": None}),
+        dict(worker_fields={"_sparse_verify": False}),

+)
+def test_sparse_verify_keeps_the_dense_gather_when_the_support_cannot_match(
+    case, monkeypatch
+):
+    """Only a sampled batch with top_k <= 64, no logit adjustment and unpadded vocab
+    shards may skip the dense gather; top_k -1 or above 64 keeps it."""
+    from sglang.srt.speculative import dflash_worker_v2 as worker_mod
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        worker_mod,
+        "pack_shard_topk",
+        lambda *args, **kwargs: pytest.fail("the dense gather must run"),
+    )
+    support, gathered = _sparse_verify_support(monkeypatch, **case)
+    assert support is None and gathered == []
+
+
+def test_sparse_verify_gathers_rank_major_shards_with_global_ids(monkeypatch):
+    """The merge reads rank r's candidates at gathered rows r * rows.., with ids
+    offset by r * shard_width."""
+    from sglang.srt.speculative import dflash_worker_v2 as worker_mod
+
+    calls = []
+
+    def fake_pack(logits_shard, *, max_top_k, col_offset):
+        calls.append(("pack", max_top_k, col_offset))
+        return torch.zeros(logits_shard.shape[0], 256, dtype=torch.int32)
+
+    def fake_merge(gathered, *, world, softcap, max_top_k):
+        calls.append(("merge", world, softcap, max_top_k))
+        return "support"
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(worker_mod, "pack_shard_topk", fake_pack)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(worker_mod, "merge_shard_topk", fake_merge)
+
+    support, gathered = _sparse_verify_support(monkeypatch, rank=2)
+    assert support == "support"
+    assert calls == [
+        ("pack", 64, 2 * _SPARSE_SHARD),
+        ("merge", _SPARSE_WORLD, 20.0, 64),

+    assert gathered == [torch.Size([_SPARSE_WORLD * 4 * 8, 256])]

[by Claude Code] **Severity: functional | Confidence: High**

**Issue**

`_sparse_verify` does not check that the target has a final logit softcap. With `SGLANG_OPT_DFLASH_SPARSE_VERIFY=1`, a target without softcap, a selector draft, and TP > 1, `prewarm_sampling` calls `_prewarm_sparse_verify`. It passes `final_logit_softcapping=None` to `merge_shard_topk` (line 873). Triton turns a `None` argument into a constexpr, so `x = x / softcap` in `_merge_support_kernel` fails to compile and the scheduler fails at startup. The startup log also says sparse verify is enabled, but verify never defers the gather for such a target.

**Fix**

Add `and bool(self._target_logits_processor.final_logit_softcapping)` to this condition. That matches the softcap check in `LogitsProcessor._can_gather_softcap_fused`.

**Issue**

With the flag on, the new kernels decide which draft tokens are accepted and which bonus token is sampled, so this change can affect model outputs. Please add one accuracy score, for example GSM8K or GPQA, for Muse-Spark-Open NVFP4 on GB300 with `SGLANG_OPT_DFLASH_SPARSE_VERIFY` off and on. Use top_k 64 sampling so the sparse path runs.
